properties.description: A branch exports three times, merges main mid-way, exports again during the merge, then squash-merges. PASS: every changed item's prev_item_hash equals that item's hash at the merge-base; unchanged items keep main's hashes; the gate's per-item LINEAGE check exits 0; and the design's item chains reconstruct the history without git. Reproduces #571's fourth CI failure (an export mid-merge chaining from the older main).
properties.findings: 2026-10-03 (chg:the-design-is-saved-one-file-per-item-2026-10-03): test_item_lineage_stays_one_hop_through_a_mid_merge_export_and_a_squash: a branch exports three times (each committed), main moves by a squash-merged PR, the branch merges main and exports DURING the merge, then squash-merges; every changed item's prev_item_hash equals its hash at the merge-base, every unchanged item keeps main's bytes, reflow2_check.check_item_lineage is clean on the branch and on the squash commit (trunk), and along main's first-parent history each changed item names its previous commit's hash (one hop per commit). test_a_hand_edited_prev_is_named_by_the_lineage_check: a forged prev is named.
properties.name: Per-item lineage stays one hop after a squash-merge and after an export taken mid-merge
